limits: Toy two-layer hidden64 FP32 module, local batch4; not the S4096 training benchmark.
Module errors are the pinned worker recorded comparisons to plain CPU autograd; raw full gradient arrays were not exported for a second offline recomputation.
No clipping or optimizer; does not establish BF16/FP16, all hardware/versions or full training tensor equivalence.
Does not identify step1804 cause, attention gradient noise floor, HSDP pack FQN or communication critical path.
Device ownership observations are discrete; no continuous-exclusivity or performance claim.
